S046-thm:path-prod.title: thm:path-prod
S046-thm:path-prod.difficulty_reason: 结论 H2。题面（basics.tex:1249-1251，\label{thm:path-prod}；HoTT Book §2.6 笛卡尔积类型，即 Theorem 2.6.2）逐字为“For any $x$ and $y$, the function~\eqref{eq:path-prod} is an equivalence.”，只给出一条已定义的函数 \eqref{eq:path-prod}（由证明中“since $\apfunc{\proj1}$ and $\apfunc{\proj2}$ are defined by path induction,~\eqref{eq:path-prod} takes $r\jdeq \refl{x}$ to the pair $(\refl{\proj1x},\refl{\proj2x})$”可知即 $p\mapsto(\ap{\proj1}p,\ap{\proj2}p)$，型为 $(\id[A\times B]{x}{y})\to(\id[A]{\proj1(x)}{\proj1(y)})\times(\id[B]{\proj2(x)}{\proj2(y)})$），要求证明它是等价。实质要求两步，且两步都由本证明自己做完：(a) 造出反向映射“We need a function in the other direction:”，即 \eqref{eq:path-prod-inverse} $(\id[A]{\proj1(x)}{\proj1(y)})\times(\id[B]{\proj2(x)}{\proj2(y)})\to(\id[A\times B]{x}{y})$——先“By the induction rule for cartesian products, we may assume that $x$ and $y$ are both pairs”，再“Now by induction for the cartesian product in its domain, we may assume given $p:a=a'$ and $q:b=b'$”，“And by two path inductions, we may assume that $a\jdeq a'$ and $b\jdeq b'$ and both $p$ and $q$ are reflexivity”，末了“But in this case, we have $(a,b)\jdeq(a',b')$ and so we can take the output to also be reflexivity”；(b) 验证它是 \eqref{eq:path-prod} 的拟逆：“It remains to prove that~\eqref{eq:path-prod-inverse} is quasi-inverse to~\eqref{eq:path-prod}. This is a simple sequence of inductions, but they have to be done in the right order.”，两个方向分别是对 $r$ 路径归纳→对 $x$ 归纳（“We first do a path induction on $r$ in order to assume that $x\jdeq y$ and $r$ is reflexivity.”），与对 $x,y$ 归纳→对 $s$ 归纳→对 $p,q$ 归纳（“Now by induction on $p$ and $q$, we may assume they are reflexivities $\refl a$ and $\refl b$, in which case~\eqref{eq:path-prod-inverse} yields $\refl{(a,b)}$ and then~\eqref{eq:path-prod} returns us to $(\refl a,\refl b)\jdeq (p,q)\jdeq s$.”）。允许引用什么：笛卡尔积的消去/归纳规则、路径归纳、$\refl$ 的判定性计算与 $\jdeq$ 归约，以及 $\apfunc{\proj1}$、$\apfunc{\proj2}$ 的定义展开；结论中的“等价”经拟逆的标准事实兑现；证明中不含任何 \cref/命题引用，逆映射与两条同伦都没有外包给已证结论。哪些部分必须由本证明完成：(a) 的反向映射与 (b) 的两条同伦全部由本证明给出，故第 (i) 条形式上满足。但 (ii)(iii) 不满足：结论是第 2 章关于恒等类型在积类型上分解的基础结构恒等式，属全书通用工具而非研究级结果；机制全部是教材标准件——积的归纳规则、两次路径归纳、$\jdeq$ 判定性等式、以 $\refl$ 收尾，逆映射无非把两条分量路径经消去规则拼回 $\refl{(a,b)}$，没有题面之外的自造对象、没有新机制（唯一可核对的技术点只是归纳次序，原文自称 “a simple sequence of inductions”），正是第 (iii) 条所指的教材工具引理。据经验条款“教材里的引理大多属工具引理 ⇒ 判 H2 是正常的”，判 H2，不抬档。原文定位：basics.tex:1249-1251（statement）、basics.tex:1259-1284（proof）。
S046-thm:path-prod.h3_criterion_note: 决定性的一步 = \eqref{eq:path-prod} 的拟逆的构造与验证：反向函数由积归纳＋（在定义域上的）积归纳＋两次路径归纳定义为 $(\refl a,\refl b)\mapsto\refl{(a,b)}$，两个复合的同伦也由有序归纳给出——逐字“It remains to prove that~\eqref{eq:path-prod-inverse} is quasi-inverse to~\eqref{eq:path-prod}. This is a simple sequence of inductions, but they have to be done in the right order.”。承担者：本证明自身（basics.tex:1259-1284），逆映射与两条同伦均未被任何被引命题替代，故 (i) 成立。为何不是 H3：不满足 (iii)——它是教材工具引理，机制全为标准件（定义展开、积的消去/归纳规则、路径归纳、$\refl$ 的判定性计算），没有自造对象或新机制；同时 (ii) 意义上它只是第 2 章的基础结构恒等式（$\id[A\times B]{x}{y}$ 与 $(\id[A]{\proj1(x)}{\proj1(y)})\times(\id[B]{\proj2(x)}{\proj2(y)})$ 的积情形），不是冠名主定理级的研究结果。同批 thm:path-sigma（B12-05）属同一模式，同判 H2。

S046-thm:modal-char.title: thm:modal-char
S046-thm:modal-char.difficulty_reason: 实质要求：对任意 reflective subuniverse \P，证明 (i)『$A:\P$ 且 $B:A\to \P$ ⇒ $\sm{x:A} B(x)$ 在 \P 中』(\ref{item:mchr1}) 与 (ii)『对任意 $A:\type$、$B:\reflect A\to\P$、$g:\prd{a:A} B(\project(a))$，存在 $f:\prd{z:\reflect A} B(z)$ 使 $f(\project(a)) = g(a)$』(\ref{item:mchr2}) 逻辑等价；题面只说 'the following are logically equivalent'（dump 40 行），不给任何见证，两个方向的存在性对象都必须由本证明造出。本证明承担的核心构造：方向一（(i)⇒(ii)）先由 (i) 得 $\sm{z:\reflect A} B(z)$ 在 \P 中，令 $g'(a)\defeq (\project(a),g(a))$（49 行）并取 $\rec{\modal}(g')$（50 行）；再由『两个映射 precompose $\project$ 后相等，故由 $\reflect$ 的万有性质已相等』得 $p_z:\proj1(\rec{\modal}(g')(z)) = z$（54 行）；决定性一步是 $f(z) \defeq \trans{p_z}{\proj2(\rec{\modal}(g')(z))}$（57 行）——用 $p_z$ 把第二分量搬运到正确的纤维里，以修正不对的第一分量；这条机制在本节任何被引命题中都没有。方向二（(ii)⇒(i)）造复合 $h$（69 行）并算 $h(\project(z)) = \proj1(z)$（72-74 行），令 $C(w)\defeq B(h(w))$、$g(z)\defeq \trans{p_z}{\proj2(z)}$（78 行），由 (ii) 取 $f$，再令 $k(w) \defeq (h(w),f(w))$（88 行）并证 $k$ 是 $\project_{\sm{x:A}B(x)}$ 的 retraction，收尾 'Therefore, $\sm{x:A}B(x)$ is in \P.'（89 行）。允许引用：\ref{defn:reflective-subuniverse} 的 $\rec$／万有性质与其 adjunction 性质、$\rec$ 的 β 计算规则、$\trans$、以及『modal 的 retract 仍 modal』。唯一被以 'one can show' 托付的是 59-64 行的相干性（把 $f(\project(a)) = g(a)$ 归到『$\rec{\modal}(g')(\project(a))$ 的第一分量等于 $p_{\project(a)}$』），它是本证明内部的一步而非整条命题的外包，故 (i) 成立。按 (ii)：这正是 modality 的奠基性刻画（Σ-封闭 ⇔ 模态型上的依赖消去），属 §7.7（Modalities）的章节级定理，(ii) 成立。按 (iii)：环境为 thm、标签即 thm:modal-char，两条条件还被加上 \label 供后文引用，说明它承担该节的定义性内容，不是随手调用的工具引理；其对象（$f$、$h$、$C$、$k$）由本证明造出，机制无法由任何被引命题取得，不落入 (iii) 的排除项，判 H3。诚实备注：题面只要求逻辑等价（不构造等价），且相干性一步在书中写作 'one can show'，故本条处 H3 下沿。原文定位：hlevels.tex statement_lines=[1746, 1752]、proof_lines=[1753, 1796]；dump 38-45 为 STATEMENT、46-90 为 PROOF。
S046-thm:modal-char.h3_criterion_note: 决定性的一步＝在仅有 Σ-封闭的假设下造出模态型 $\reflect A$ 上的依赖截面 $f$（即 (ii) 的存在性断言），以及反方向把 $\sm{x:A}B(x)$ 表示为 $\project_{\sm{x:A}B(x)}$ 的 retract 的 $k$。承担者＝本证明自身：$f$ 由 $f(z) \defeq \trans{p_z}{\proj2(\rec{\modal}(g')(z))}$（dump 57 行）显式造出（先取 $\rec{\modal}(g')$、再由万有性质得 $p_z$、最后沿 $p_z$ 搬运第二分量），$k$ 由 $k(w) \defeq (h(w),f(w))$（88 行）显式造出；书中没有任何被引命题可代劳——『用 $p_z$ 修正第一分量』正是本条特有的机制，单靠等价搬运／路径归纳／定义展开给不出。为何不是常规辅助步骤：(a) 它是 §7.7（Modalities）中给出 modality 依赖消去刻画的章节级主定理（环境 thm、\label{thm:modal-char}，且 (mchr1)/(mchr2) 被加 label 供后文引用），不是被随手调用的工具引理；(b) 题面不提供任何见证，$f$、$h$、$C$、$k$ 全由本证明造出；(c) 被引的只是 $\rec$／万有性质、$\rec$ 的 β 规则、$\trans$ 与『modal 的 retract 仍 modal』，它们都不蕴含 $f$ 的存在。故 (i)(ii)(iii) 同时成立。诚实备注：相干性一步在书中写作 'one can show'（59-64 行），题面亦只说逻辑等价，故本条判 H3 但属下沿。

S046-RC-sim-eqv-le.difficulty_reason: HoTT Book 第 11 章 reals.tex（§11.3 Cauchy reals 的 "The algebraic structure of Cauchy reals" 小节，紧随 \begin{lem}\label{thm:RC-lt-open}（reals.tex:1563）之后；statement_lines=[1578, 1582]，proof_lines=[1583, 1606]，proof_bytes=2008）。实质要求：对任意 $u, v : \RC$ 与 $\epsilon : \Qp$ 证明 $\eqv{(u \close\epsilon v)}{(|u - v| < \rcrat(\epsilon))}$，即把与 $\RC$ 同时以 HIIT 方式定义的辅助关系 $\closesym$ 与度量不等式对齐；定义处已声明 intended meaning："The intended meaning of $x \close\epsilon y$ is $|x - y| < \epsilon$, but since we do not have notions of subtraction, absolute value, or inequality available yet (we are only just defining $\RC$, after all), we will have to define these relations $\close\epsilon$ at the same time as we define $\RC$ itself."（reals.tex:721），本条即兑现之，正文冠以 "We are now able to show that the auxiliary relation $\closesym$ is what we think it is."（reals.tex:1576）。左到右：先由减法与绝对值的 Lipschitz 性归约到 "it will suffice to show that if $u\close\epsilon 0$, then $|u|<\rcrat(\epsilon)$"（dump:103），再对 $u$ 做 $\RC$-induction；$u=\rclim(x)$ 时 "by roundedness we have $\theta:\Qp$ with $\rclim(x)\close{\epsilon-\theta} 0$"（dump:107），三角不等式给出 "$x_{\theta/3} \close{\epsilon-2\theta/3} 0$"（dump:108），末步由 \cref{thm:RC-lt-open}\ref{item:RCltopen1} 收（dump:109）。右到左："we use $\RC$-induction on $u$ and $v$"（dump:111），混合构造子情形自行配误差——序稠密性给出 $\theta<\epsilon$（dump:116），经 Lipschitz 性与 \cref{thm:RC-lt-open}\ref{item:RCltopen1} 把目标降到归纳假设可用的 "$|\rcrat(q) - y_\delta| < \rcrat(\theta+2\delta)$"（dump:119），再由三角不等式合成 $\rcrat(q)\close{\theta+4\delta} \rclim(y)$（dump:120），末句 "Thus, it suffices to choose $\delta \defeq (\epsilon-\theta)/4$."（dump:121）；第四情形只写 "The remaining two cases are entirely analogous."（dump:123）。允许引用：$\RC$-induction、roundedness、三角不等式（item:RC-sim-triangle）、减法与绝对值的 Lipschitz 性（RC-binary-nonexpanding-extension）、$\Q$ 在 $\RC$ 中的序稠密性，以及紧邻引理 \cref{thm:RC-lt-open}\ref{item:RCltopen1}。必须由本证明完成：两个方向的误差记账（$\theta/3$ 配比与 $\delta=(\epsilon-\theta)/4$）与四个构造子情形的拼装——没有任何被引命题直接断言该等价，故 (i) 大体成立；(ii) 亦成立（它使 §11.3 的完备性小节能把两种 Cauchy 逼近概念等同："Thanks to \cref{RC-sim-eqv-le} there is no difference between a Cauchy approximation $x : \Qp \to \RC$ as defined in the construction of $\RC$, and a Cauchy approximation in the sense of \cref{defn:cauchy-approximation}"，reals.tex:1728-1731，另见 reals.tex:1735 用它与 \cref{thm:RC-sim-lim-term} 说明 $\rclim(x)$ 是极限）。但 (iii) 不成立：本条是教材里的工具引理——书中自称 $\closesym$ 为辅助关系、本定理只是把它「对齐」，且后文两处把它当工具引用；机制全为标准件（$\RC$-induction、roundedness 取 $\theta$、三角不等式、Lipschitz 性搬运、序稠密性插点、$\epsilon/4$ 常数配置），无自造对象或新机制，对象（$\RC$、$\closesym$、序、减法与绝对值）全部由 HIIT 定义/题面给出，连两个对称情形都略去；同小节的冠名主定理是紧随其后的 \cref{RC-archimedean-ordered-field}（reals.tex:1720）。故判 H2。

S046-RC-squaring.title: RC-squaring
S046-RC-squaring.difficulty_reason: HoTT Book Thm 10.1.6 (reals.tex:1636-1646), env=thm, in sec:algebr-struct-cauchy ("The algebraic structure of Cauchy reals"). Statement: there exists a UNIQUE (blank)^2 : RC -> RC extending rational squaring and satisfying forall n, u,v:[-n,n], |u^2-v^2| <= 2*n*|u-v|. Substantive requirement: build a global function on the Cauchy reals out of countably many locally Lipschitz pieces, then prove it unique. Allowed to cite: \cref{ex:traditional-archimedean} (archimedean boundedness), \cref{RC-extend-Q-Lipschitz} (the section's Lipschitz-extension lemma, reals.tex:1077-1080), \cref{RC-Lipschitz-on-interval}, \cref{RC-continuous-eq} (uniqueness of extensions of continuous maps agreeing on rationals, reals.tex:1376), and \cref{lem:images_are_coequalizers}. Parts the present proof must itself do: (a) supply the boundedness datum on the request of the cited exercise to conclude "for every $u : \RC$ there merely exists $n : \N$ such that $-n \leq u \leq n$", hence that e:(Sigma n:N)[-n,n] -> RC, e(n,x) := x "is surjective"; (b) exhibit s_n(q) := q^2 on {q:Q | -n <= q <= n} with the explicit constant 2n and feed it to the extension lemma to obtain sbar_n:[-n,n] -> RC; (c) build the compatibility of the pieces by the cited continuous-eq lemma ("if $m < n$ ... then $s_n$ restricted to $[-m, m]$ must agree with $s_m$ because both are Lipschitz"), which is genuine work not supplied by the extension lemma; (d) assemble step (c) — via the coequalizer form of the image factorization — into the descended, unique map, which is exactly what makes the theorem's uniqueness half true. Why only H2: the decisive step (i) of the descent is "Therefore, by \cref{lem:images_are_coequalizers} the map ... factors uniquely through $\RC$", i.e. the existence-and-uniqueness half is discharged by a cited general theorem about the category of sets (setmath.tex:267, "The category $\uset$ is regular. Moreover, surjective functions between sets are regular epimorphisms"), whose proof in turn outsources to the orthogonal factorization system and to a standard category-theory lemma ("It is a standard lemma in category theory that a category is regular as soon as it admits finite limits and a pullback-stable orthogonal factorization system"). The patching mechanism itself is the section's generic toolkit (RC-extend-Q-Lipschitz + RC-continuous-eq) applied without modification. So although the result has real structural weight (it is the input to the polarization identity of eq. (mult-from-square) that defines multiplication on RC, reals.tex:1612-1622), it is a section-level derived application, not a result whose decisive step is carried by this proof. H1 is too low because the proof does build the covering, establish surjectivity and verify compatibility of the local extensions, none of which is a mere definition chase.
S046-RC-squaring.h3_criterion_note: Decisive step: the factoring/descent step — "Therefore, by \cref{lem:images_are_coequalizers} the map ... \Parens{\sm{n : \N} [-n, n]} -> \RC, ... (n, x) \mapsto s_n(x) ... factors uniquely through $\RC$ to give us the desired function." Both halves of the theorem (existence and uniqueness of (blank)^2) are delivered by that cited coequalizer property of the image; the present proof only prepares its hypotheses (surjectivity of e, compatibility of sbar_n). On the other side, the local pieces sbar_n come from another cited lemma, \cref{RC-extend-Q-Lipschitz}, applied verbatim. Since the core step is carried by a citation, criterion (i) fails, hence the entry is at most H2; not H3. It is nevertheless not a tool lemma: a covering of RC by intervals and the gluing of a partially defined operation across it is a genuine construction, and the compatibility verification is real work — hence H2 and not H1.
